https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfre.title: The Guardian view on Gaza’s misery: don’t let Palestinian deaths mount in this bleak winter | Editorial
https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfre.author: Editorial
https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfre.text:
What do you call a ceasefire when the firing has not ceased? The killings in Gaza decreased when the truce was announced last October, but they did not end. Israel’s strike on Thursday morning on one of the few remaining functioning hospitals, which killed six people and wounded 28 more, was the first on a healthcare facility since then. But it was not an anomaly. About four Palestinians a day have died on average since the ceasefire was declared.
The Israeli military said that it had struck a Hamas commander and other fighters in the attack on Nasser hospital, without providing evidence. Its record does not inspire confidence in the accuracy of its account. Multiple UN experts and health campaigners have warned of the deliberate targeting of medical facilities and healthcare workers. Israeli military personnel have also described the shockingly high level of civilian deaths tolerated as “collateral damage” in targeting even low-level fighters after the brutal Hamas attacks of 7 October 2023.
Many more Palestinians are dying because of the war. With more than four-fifths of Gaza’s buildings destroyed, storms and the cold are proving deadly, killing at least four children and a woman last weekend. The UN says that 940,000 people are in makeshift shelters in areas at risk of flooding. Sewage is spewing into tents. In desperation, families are risking a return to ruined homes – with some dying in building collapses.
Reconstruction is the real need, but even the absolute basics are lacking: the UN says Israel is blocking 150,000 tents that are ready for use, along with other sorely needed goods, including sanitation equipment and nutrient-dense peanut butter. As an occupying power, Israel has a responsibility under international law to meet the needs of Gaza’s people. Allowing in the aid they desperately need should be the absolute minimum expected of it.
Even Donald Trump’s Netanyahu-friendly Board of Peace has urged Israel to allow in all humanitarian supplies and said that its response is insufficient – but it shows no inclination to actually use its leverage. Israel says that it has let in trucks and tents but that reconstruction can’t begin until Hamas “fully disarms”.
Gadi Eisenkot, a former head of the military, has six weeks to form a government following elections last month, in which Benjamin Netanyahu lost his mandate. Substantial improvements are unlikely even if Mr Eisenkot succeeds; the fate of civilians in Gaza was more of an issue in the US midterms than in the Israeli election.
But as Israel gradually begins to digest the extraordinary shift in international opinion underlined by the US midterms – with about three in 10 Americans now believing that it has committed genocide – other governments have a fresh opportunity to press for change. They must use not just words but deeds. Mr Netanyahu has suggested that Israel could become an isolated “super-Sparta”. Yet it is dependent – for security, trade and diplomatically – on the US and Europe.
Other nations must also pay up: shockingly, the World Food Programme said last month that it has had to cut the number of people it can help by half a million because funding has slumped. Israel’s obstruction increases the cost of relief, and its barring of aid groups is another obstacle. Now is the time to exert maximum pressure to ensure that Palestinians can survive this winter – and that they have a future worth living for.

https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.title: Mostra Correnteza ocupa cinemas do Recife com produções negras e afro-indígenas a partir desta quinta-feira (12)
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.author: Fátima Pereira
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.text:
O Recife recebe, entre esta quinta-feira (12) e o domingo (15), a terceira edição da Correnteza – Mostra Internacional de Cinema Atlântico, com programação gratuita no Cinema São Luiz, no Cinema da Fundação (Derby) e na Praça do Morro da Conceição, onde haverá uma sessão ao ar livre. A iniciativa reúne produções audiovisuais que abordam experiências afro-indígenas, diásporas nas Américas e cinemas experimentais, além de promover encontros, cursos e masterclasses voltados à reflexão sobre imagem, identidade e produção cultural.
Um dos destaques da abertura é a exibição de Yeelen (1987), do cineasta malinês Souleymane Cissé. A sessão acontece nesta quinta-feira (12), às 19h, no Cinema São Luiz, e conta com a curadoria da Semana do Cinema Negro de Belo Horizonte, convidada desta edição. Premiado pelo Júri do Festival de Cannes, o longa terá exibição única durante a mostra.
A programação também apresenta A Different Image (1982), da cineasta afro-americana Alile Sharon Larkin, integrante do movimento L.A. Rebellion, importante referência na consolidação do cinema negro independente nos Estados Unidos. O filme também terá sessão única nesta quinta-feira, às 19h, no Cinema São Luiz.
Entre as atividades abertas ao público está o Correnteza na Rua, realizado pelo Cinema Sem Teto, ligado ao Movimento dos Trabalhadores Sem Teto (MTST). A sessão acontece na sexta-feira (13), às 17h30, na Praça do Morro da Conceição, com exibição de curtas-metragens do catálogo do Clube Descoloniza, iniciativa da distribuidora Descoloniza Filmes que disponibiliza obras para cineclubes brasileiros.
O encerramento será no domingo (15), às 18h, no Cinema São Luiz, com o longa “Não Estamos Sonhando” (2026), do diretor alagoano Ulisses Arthur. A produção integrou a mostra Première Brasil: Competição Novos Rumos, do Festival do Rio deste ano, e representa a presença do cinema nordestino contemporâneo na seleção.
A terceira edição também amplia o espaço dedicado à formação audiovisual. Entre as atividades estão uma masterclass online sobre narrativas especulativas, uma conversa sobre festivais de cinemas negros e um curso sobre música eletrônica africana e afrodiaspórica. As ações presenciais serão realizadas no Instituto Cervantes Recife, no Bairro do Recife.
No sábado (14), o jornalista, pesquisador e crítico musical GG Albuquerque ministra o curso Afrotrônicos – Música eletrônica entre África e diásporas, das 9h às 11h e das 13h às 15h, no Instituto Cervantes. A atividade propõe um percurso por manifestações musicais como singeli, kuduro, balani show e funk, observando as experimentações sonoras e tecnológicas desenvolvidas em diferentes territórios africanos e diaspóricos.
A programação internacional inclui ainda os filmes El Coloquio de los Pájaros (2026), da peruana Sofía Velázquez Núñez, e Soñé su nombre (2026), da colombiana Ángela Carabalí. As obras integram a parceria com o Instituto Cervantes Recife e reforçam a presença de realizadoras contemporâneas da América do Sul na mostra.
Criada em 2021, a Correnteza surgiu com a proposta de ampliar a participação de pessoas racializadas no mercado cinematográfico e na pesquisa sobre audiovisual. O projeto articula exibição, formação e intercâmbio, valorizando diferentes perspectivas estéticas, políticas e narrativas sobre as experiências negras e indígenas.
A realização da edição de 2026 conta com incentivo da Secretaria de Cultura e do Governo de Pernambuco, por meio da Política Nacional Aldir Blanc (PNAB), do Ministério da Cultura e do Governo Federal. O evento também tem apoio da Prefeitura do Recife, do Instituto Cervantes Recife, da Embaixada da Espanha no Brasil, do Cinema São Luiz e do Cinema da Fundação.
As atividades formativas são gratuitas, mas exigem inscrição prévia, disponível aqui: https://forms.gle/fBQz7d2uftPC4z6z7.

https://www.artnews.com/art-news/news/ne.title: Newark Museum Is Latest Art Institution to Transfer Ownership of David Drake Vessel
https://www.artnews.com/art-news/news/ne.author: Alex Greenberger
https://www.artnews.com/art-news/news/ne.text:
The latest institution to transfer its ownership of a David Drake vessel in its collection is New Jersey’s Newark Museum of Art, which said on Thursday that the artist’s descendants were given possession of an 1852 jug.
Other museums have undertaken a similar measure, from the Museum of Fine Arts Boston to the Virginia Museum of Fine Arts. But the Newark Museum said in its release that, unlike past ownership transfers, this one was initiated by the institution, which reached out to Drake’s descendants, rather than the other way around.
Drake is now widely recognized for the stoneware jugs he produced during the 19th century in Edgefield, South Carolina. He was born into enslavement and achieved freedom sometime after the Civil War. The jugs, which memorably figured in a 2022 Metropolitan Museum of Art exhibition, sometimes bore written messages whose meaning has often been debated. One vessel by him topped ARTnews’s list of the best artworks about America earlier this year.
The Newark Museum work was inscribed with the date “March 14, 1852,” and was signed by Drake—under a version of his first name, Dave—along with the initials LM. Those initials reference Lewis Miles, on whose plantation Drake was enslaved. It is displayed galleries for 18th- and 19th-century American art, and will remain on view while the ownership is transferred.
Over the summer, the museum reached out to Drake’s descendants. A release said that now, “with full support of the board of trustees,” the jug’s ownership was given over to the family and subsequently repurchased.
Lisa Funderbunke, the Newark Museum’s director and CEO, said in a statement, “We are deeply grateful to David Drake’s descendants for their trust and partnership. Restoring ownership of this work is an important act of justice, one that is rooted in accountability, repair and healing, and reflects the values guiding NMOA’s next chapter. As the Museum enters a new era, we are honored to continue sharing Drake’s legacy with the public in partnership with his family.”
Yaba Barker, Drake’s fourth great-grandson, said in a statement, “For over 175 years, our ancestor’s vessels have carried stories and history that must be told. Thanks to this agreement, our family’s mission for Dave’s work to be accessible to the public, and for viewers to recognize us as Dave’s heirs and owners of his legacy, is being fulfilled by Newark Museum’s leadership, and we are so grateful.”
Though the Newark Museum did not report a price for repurchasing the jug, Eileen Kinsella reported in the Art Newspaper that the transaction will cost “around $135,000,” a figure that is considerably lower than Drake’s auction record.

Le ministère israélien des Affaires étrangères, Gidéon Saar a annoncé l'interdiction de territoire des deux élus ce 12 novembre, reprochant aux deux responsables insoumis leurs dénonciations des crimes commis à Gaza et en Cisjordanie.
« Interdit d’entrer sur un territoire où je n’ai pas demandé à entrer. » Jean-Luc Mélenchon a réagi sur France Info à la décision annoncée jeudi 12 novembre par Israël de lui fermer ses frontières. « Je regrette que le gouvernement d’Israël me poursuive de cette manière », a ajouté le fondateur de La France insoumise. Mathilde Panot, présidente du groupe LFI à l’Assemblée nationale, est également visée, a précisé le ministre des Affaires étrangères sortant, Gidéon Saar.
Son ministère impute à LFI une « position extrêmement hostile à Israël ». « Tous deux ont tenu des propos relayant des accusations mensongères de crimes imputés à Israël », affirme le communiqué, qui reproche aussi à Jean-Luc Mélenchon d’avoir appelé « à ce que des navires français escortent des flottilles illégales à destination de Gaza ».
Les autorités israéliennes ont aussi empêché notre envoyé spécial Sylvain Mercadier d’entrer dans le pays, mi-octobre. Il devait couvrir les élections législatives et réaliser des reportages en Cisjordanie. Malgré les démarches effectuées avant son départ, son autorisation de voyage avait été révoquée pendant son escale à Sofia. Aucune justification n’avait été transmise à notre rédaction, dont les demandes d’explications étaient restées sans réponse.

https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.title: Lula cobra pedido de desculpas da imprensa sobre triplex em Guarujá
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.author: Paula Laboissière
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.text:
O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva disse nesta quinta-feira (12) que espera um pedido de desculpas, por parte da imprensa brasileira, sobre o caso envolvendo um apartamento triplex em Guarujá (SP).
“Fiquei 580 dias preso, dizendo que o apartamento não era meu. Agora que a Justiça decidiu que o apartamento não era meu, eu só espero que as pessoas que me acusaram e as pessoas que falaram durante anos que o apartamento era meu pedissem desculpa”, disse.
O pedido de retratação foi feito durante live no canal Exército do Lula, em companhia do deputado federal André Janones (Rede-MG). A transmissão foi feita a partir da Turquia, onde o presidente participa da 31ª Conferência das Nações Unidas sobre Mudanças Climáticas, a COP31.
“Que não fizessem rodapé e matéria de jornal, mas pedissem desculpas em letras garrafais, do mesmo tamanho que vocês fizeram a acusação. É o mínimo que eu espero daqueles que se dizem democratas nesse país”, completou.
Justiça
Na semana passada, a Justiça Federal determinou que todo o dinheiro obtido com o leilão de um tríplex em Guarujá seja entregue ao grupo da empreiteira OAS. O imóvel havia sido atribuído a Lula em investigações da Operação Lava Jato.
Na decisão, o juiz Marcelo Gentil Monteiro, da 12ª Vara Federal Criminal de Brasília, observou não haver investigação em curso ou outro motivo jurídico que justifique a retenção dos R$ 2,4 milhões arrecadados com o leilão, realizado em 2018.
Entenda
O apartamento no Edifício Solaris, na orla de Guarujá, foi apontado pela força-tarefa da Lava Jato como sendo de propriedade de Lula, apesar de o imóvel sempre ter permanecido registrado como patrimônio da OAS.
Segundo a Lava Jato, o imóvel teria sido destinado a Lula pela OAS como vantagem indevida, em troca de favorecimento à empreiteira em contratos com a Petrobras.
O caso levou à condenação de Lula, que ficou preso por 580 dias, entre abril de 2018 e novembro de 2019.
As decisões contra Lula, entretanto, acabaram anuladas por decisão do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), em razão de nulidades no processo de investigação e nas decisões da 13ª Vara Federal de Curitiba, onde tramitou.
A defesa do presidente sempre acusou motivação política de integrantes da Lava Jato e apontou não haver provas concretas de que ele detinha a posse do imóvel.
O STF determinou que a apuração do caso fosse reiniciada na Justiça Federal de Brasília. O Ministério Público Federal (MPF), contudo, pediu o arquivamento do processo devido ao fim do prazo legal para que os supostos crimes fossem punidos, caso provados. A ação, então, foi arquivada.
Agora, a Justiça Federal acatou o pedido da OAS para reaver o dinheiro obtido com o leilão judicial do imóvel. O pedido foi corroborado pelo MPF, que concordou com a liberação da quantia, uma vez que não há nenhum processo que justifique a retenção dos valores.
Atualmente, o dinheiro encontra-se depositado em conta judicial aberta na Caixa e deve ser transferido à empreiteira após os procedimentos legais.

https://www.artnews.com/art-news/news/se.title: ‘Secret’ Location of a Vandalized and Rescued Banksy Revealed
https://www.artnews.com/art-news/news/se.author: Brian Boucher
https://www.artnews.com/art-news/news/se.text:
A Banksy mural with a checkered past has been located by sleuths at the British Broadcasting Service (BBC). The semi-anonymous artist painted the piece in 2018 on Scott Street Bridge in Hull, a port city in East Yorkshire, England. The BBC has discovered that it is being kept in storage in Norfolk, more than 120 miles away, and that its future is unknown.
The mural shows a young boy, apparently dressed for battle in a helmet and raising wooden sword with a pencil attacked to its tip. He cries out “draw the raised bridge!” as he seems to sit on a graffiti writer’s tag. The joke being that the work is adorned on a bridge set to be razed: It’s been closed to traffic since 1994 due to its poor condition, frozen in a raised position. Banksy also plays with the notion of the pen being mightier than the sword, attaching an actual writing implement to a mock weapon.
While Banksy does not typically explain his works, some saw a commentary on Brexit; the referendum took place in 2016, and Hull voted 68% to separate from the European Union. The piece was painted over in white by vandals but quickly saved by a fast-acting window cleaner who rushed to save it. Some saw irony in the fact that authorities in Hull, named the UK’s “city of culture” in 2017, failed to protect the piece.
According to a city filing, the Hull City Council said it would pay a company some £60,000 ($79,420) to move the 22-foot-wide mural to the city’s Trinity Market, where it would also build and install a display case for the piece. The city council has not replied to repeated BBC requests as to whether the contract was awarded.
“Nobody will tell us where this painting is and when it’s going to be put on display,” local councilor Rosie Nicola told the news network. “It’s wrong.”
The whereabouts of the sculpture were hinted at in 2025, during a meeting of a committee of the council, when Angela Blake, the city’s assistant director of major projects, was asked where the artwork was. “It’s a secret,” she replied. Chris Jackson, the council’s executive director for regeneration, added: “I’m not sure we’re allowed to say.”
Engineering firm Alan Wood and Partners secured a £900,000 ($1.2 million) contract to dismantle the bridge and preserve the artwork, notes the BBC.
The artist remained anonymous for years, with various rumors of his identity catching fire. In March, Reuters claimed to reveal his given name and backstory.

https://taz.de/Gewalt-in-Washington/!622.title: Gewalt in Washington D.C.: Tödliche Schießerei in der Nähe des Weißen Hauses
https://taz.de/Gewalt-in-Washington/!622.author: Hansjürgen Mai
https://taz.de/Gewalt-in-Washington/!622.text:
Gewalt in Washington D.C.: Tödliche Schießerei in der Nähe des Weißen Hauses
Mutmaßlicher Täter erschießt sich am Ende wohl selbst. Washington ist Hot-spot für Morde und Gewaltdelikte.
Ein massives Polizeiaufgebot, weitläufige Straßensperrungen und die Anweisung zu Hause zu bleiben haben in der US-Hauptstadt Washington am Donnerstag für große Aufregung gesorgt. Grund für den Großeinsatz der Polizei war eine Schießerei unweit des Weißen Hauses bei dem mindestens eine Person getötet und vier weitere verletzt wurden. Die Schießerei ereignete sich mitten im Berufsverkehr kurz vor 8 Uhr Ortszeit.
Der mutmaßliche Täter konnte vom Tatort zunächst fliehen und verbarrikadierte sich in einem naheliegenden Apartmentgebäude, wo er sich später laut Polizeiangaben per selbst tötete. Washingtons amtierender Polizeichef Jeffery Carroll sagte, dass der mutmaßliche Todesschütze offenbar eine Auseinandersetzung mit der Eigentümergemeinschaft des Apartmentgebäudes hatte. Das genaue Motiv der Tat muss allerdings noch ermittelt werden.
Die Schießerei ereignete sich in der angesagten Logan Circle Nachbarschaft, die sich etwa eine Meile nördlich des Weißen Hauses befindet. Mehrere Häuserblöcke entlang der 15th Street wurden abgesperrt und die Polizei forderte die Bevölkerung dazu auf, das Gebiet zu meiden. Die Schulen in der Umgebung verhängten eine Sicherheitssperre, die erst um 11:30 Uhr Ortszeit wieder aufgehoben wurde.
Schüsse im Fitnessstudio
Laut Augenzeugenberichten soll sich die Schießerei in einem Fitnessstudio ereignet haben. Dort soll der Verdächtige auf mindestens eine Person geschossen haben, bevor er nach draußen ging und das Feuer auf Passanten eröffnete. Eine Person soll dabei getötet worden sein. Über den Gesundheitszustand der vier Verletzten gibt es aktuell keine genaueren Informationen. Berichten zufolge soll jedoch eine der Person lebensgefährlich verletzt worden sein.
Anwohner James Spellman, der sich im Fitnessstudio aufhielt, als es zu dem Vorfall kam, erklärte gegenüber der Agentur Associated Press, dass sich etwa 50 Personen zu Tatzeit dort aufhielten. „Ein Mann fiel zu Boden und eine Blutlache trat aus. Eine Person eilte ihm zu Hilfe, doch er war sofort tot. Man hatte ihm in den Hals geschossen“, sagte er.
Washingtons Bürgermeisterin Muriel Bowser bezeichnete die Schießerei als „sinnlosen Akt von Waffengewalt“. Sie wisse, „dass viele Einwohner von D.C. durch diese Nachricht geweckt wurden und große Angst hatten“, sagte Bowser.
Oft Gewaltakte in Washington
Nach der ursprünglichen Tat verbarrikadierte sich der mutmaßliche Schütze in einer Wohnung. Wie die Polizei später mitteilte, gelang es den Behörden Kontakt zum Verdächtigen aufzunehmen. Sie hätten mehr als eine Stunde mit dem als weißen Mann identifizierten Verdächtigen sprechen und verhandeln können. Als Polizisten während des Gesprächs einen Schuss hörten, stürmten sie die Wohnung. Dort wollen sie den Verdächtigen mit einer selbst zugefügten Schussverletzung vorgefunden haben. Nach Polizei-Angaben ist der Verdächtige inzwischen verstorben.
Gewalt in der US-Hauptstadt ist nichts Neues. Mit 27,3 Morden pro 100.000 Einwohner gehörte Washington zu den gefährlichsten Städten der USA im Jahr 2024. Nach seinem Amtsantritt erklärte US-Präsident Donald Trump einen Notstand und entsandte die Nationalgarde in die Hauptstadt, mit dem Ziel dort die Kriminalität zu bekämpfen.
Laut einer Untersuchung des überparteilichen Niskanen Center Thinktanks hatte dies bisher allerdings nur bedingt Erfolg. Zwar ist die Zahl der Eigentumsdelikte gesunken. Die letzte im Oktober veröffentlichte Kriminalitätsstatistik hat gezeigt, dass die Zahl der Gewaltdelikte im Vergleich zum Vorjahreszeitraum um 11 Prozent angestiegen ist. Vor allem Körperverletzungen mit Waffengewalt haben laut Polizeistatistiken um 41 Prozent zugenommen.
Allerdings teilte die Polizei auch mit, dass Tötungsdelikte in diesem Jahr bislang um 28 Prozent zurückgegangen seien. Auch Raubüberfälle (Rückgang von 3 Prozent) und Vergewaltigungen (Rückgang von 4 Prozent) fielen leicht.

Damit wir auch morgen noch unseren Journalismus machen können, brauchen wir mehr Unterstützung für taz zahl ich. Dank Ihnen haben wir nun die 50.000 erreicht. https://www.theguardian.com/technology/n.title: Jensen Huang was a busted flush at Nvidia – he had to go | Nils Pratley
https://www.theguardian.com/technology/n.author: Nils Pratley
https://www.theguardian.com/technology/n.text:
Half the tech world made up its mind before the facts could be assessed properly. Jensen Huang was “irreplaceable”, said the chorus at the start of this week. Nvidia would melt without the co-founder’s brilliance, apparently. The chipmaker’s board had to find a way to save its genius for the sake of corporate America and the entire AI universe.
It was always nonsense because, after the passage of only a few days since his confession of infidelity, Huang looked less like a towering corporate titan and more like a political liability.
An extramarital affair is not usually a resigning matter in itself – saintliness is not an absolute requirement of the job. But the circumstances here were different. A relationship with the Chinese boss of a Singapore-based firm suspected of smuggling Nvidia chips into China? That displayed recklessness on top of mere unfaithfulness.
Did he know the Megaspeed executive, Alice Huang (no relation), was regarded as a Chinese spy by US officials? It hardly matters. In the ultra-political world of in-demand AI computer chips, there were enough reasons for him to be careful in the extreme. The conflict of interest, and the risk of landing Nvidia in a quagmire of national security inquiries in Washington, would have been obvious.
Reports of a second affair with a senior Nvidia employee compounded matters – US companies tend to be sensitive about such relationships. But the company’s directors might also have wondered what else could be revealed in coming weeks. Rule number one in these situations is to get all the bad news out on day one.
The kneejerk reaction to Jensen Huang’s resignation was 13% off the share price. That was understandable – some investors truly believed the “irreplaceable” thesis. However, sitting in Nvidia’s boardroom, the job was not to worry about the initial stock market response but about what was best for the business. For multiple reasons, it was time to “rip off the Band-Aid and take Nvidia into its next chapter”, as Dan Ives, a senior tech analyst, put it.
First, the congressional investigations will happen anyway. Democratic senators have asked administration officials to preserve all documents and communications related to the sale of Nvidia’s advanced AI chips to China. At heart, that issue is wider than Nvidia – it’s about whether US officials have themselves jeopardised the country’s lead over China in AI. But, one way or another, the company’s activities, and ties to the Trump administration, will come under scrutiny like never before. Nvidia is better placed to defend itself without Huang in the top job.
Second, his personal lobbying clout on export policy had evaporated. After this week’s revelations, he had no credibility as an advocate of looser restrictions. The political demand will be entirely in the other direction – for loopholes to be closed.
Third, there is the issue Nvidia’s underpowered board has dodged for too long: over-reliance on one individual. Never mind the risk of scandal, there is always a danger in concentrating too much day-to-day power in the hands of one individual. Nobody doubts Huang’s commercial talents, but even “godfathers of AI” in leather jackets don’t go on forever. Better to have a setup that can cope with change at the top.
Colette Kress, the chief financial officer who will stand in as chief executive, is well regarded on Wall Street. Nvidia will not be short of outside applicants on a permanent basis. And the board has heard the governance criticism that a multitrillion-dollar company ought to have an independent chair: Harvey Jones, a former chief executive at semiconductor company Synopsys and a member of the current crew of directors, has got the gig. Then comes the task of creating some proper governance checks and balances, which may require fresh faces among the independent directors.
Within a couple of hours, the fall in the share price had narrowed to 5% as investors remembered that Nvidia still has the best, and most in-demand, graphics processing units in the world and that many pioneering companies have prospered after the exit of an “irreplaceable” chief executive.
Nobody pretends the management job will be easy. Nvidia will be different, not least because the political winds in the US have shifted. But there was no point trying to cling to a chief executive, however successful, who had made himself a busted flush. Huang had to go.

https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.title: Vereadora do Psol no Rio pede suspensão de medalha Chiquinha Gonzaga para Eduarda Campopiano (PL-SP)
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.author: Redação
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.text:
A vereadora Monica Benicio (Psol) protocolou, na manhã desta quinta-feira (12), um requerimento formal perante a Presidência da Câmara Municipal do Rio de Janeiro, solicitando a imediata suspensão da entrega da Medalha de Reconhecimento Chiquinha Gonzaga à deputada estadual eleita por São Paulo, Eduarda Campopiano (PL).
A iniciativa legislativa ocorre após a aprovação da honraria, votada por aclamação na última terça-feira (10) e promulgada no Diário Oficial da Casa nesta quarta-feira (11) por meio da Resolução 13.754 de 2026.
A concessão original foi apresentada pelos vereadores Fernando Armelau (PL), Marcos Dias (PL), Alana Passos (PL) e Leniel Borel (PP), sob a justificativa de representar a expressiva votação de 1,9 milhão de eleitores obtida pela parlamentar paulista para a Assembleia Legislativa de São Paulo (Alesp).
No pedido de sobrestamento, fundamentado no artigo 323 do Regimento Interno, a vereadora Monica argumenta a existência de “absoluta impropriedade lógica e vício de finalidade” em relação ao artigo 319 do Estatuto Parlamentar.
O dispositivo regimental estabelece que a Medalha Chiquinha Gonzaga é destinada exclusivamente a homenagear personalidades femininas com atuação destacada em prol de causas democráticas, humanitárias, artísticas e culturais.
A representação ressalta que Campopiano construiu trajetória política autodeclarada como “maior inimiga das feministas”, com histórico de manifestações públicas contrárias à tipificação penal do feminicídio e às redes de proteção social às mulheres.
“Cria-se um paradoxo insuperável: utiliza-se a honraria criada para premiar a defesa das causas humanitárias e da igualdade feminina para laurear quem atua ostensivamente pelo desmonte dessas mesmas causas”, afirma o texto do requerimento de Monica Benicio.
A mobilização institucional soma-se a uma intensa reação da sociedade civil e do setor cultural. Um abaixo-assinado digital criado na plataforma Change.org pela mestre em direito Jessica Acocella alcançou 100 mil apoios logo nas primeiras 24 horas e superou a marca de 120 mil assinaturas na manhã desta quinta-feira. A autora da petição tem audiência confirmada com o mandato de Monica Benicio na tarde desta quinta-feira para a entrega formal do documento.
Artistas e cantoras como Fernanda Abreu e Zélia Duncan também manifestaram interlocução com o Legislativo carioca em apoio à suspensão da entrega.
O requerimento aponta que a comenda já celebrou referências históricas como Elza Soares, Maria Bethânia, Conceição Evaristo e Margareth Dalcolmo, e adverte que a outorga sem aderência aos preceitos regimentais degrada a credibilidade institucional do parlamento do Rio de Janeiro.

https://taz.de/Digital-Fairness-Act-der-.title: Neues Digitalgesetz der EU: Fair geht anders
https://taz.de/Digital-Fairness-Act-der-.author: Svenja Bergt
https://taz.de/Digital-Fairness-Act-der-.text:
Neues Digitalgesetz der EU : Fair geht anders
Der „Digital Fairness Act“ soll den Schutz von Verbraucher:innen im Netz stärken. Gute Idee – doch dafür fehlt etwas Entscheidendes.
E ndlich eine Abschaltfunktion für süchtig machende Social-Media-Funktionen wie endloses Scrollen und Autoplay. Ein Verbot von Dark Patterns, also Designs, die Nutzende beispielsweise zum Kaufen animieren, indem sie künstliche Verknappung suggerieren. Und klare Regeln für Werbung, die Influencer:innen auf Plattformen von Tiktok bis Instagram machen. Das und noch mehr hat die EU-Kommission am Mittwoch mit ihrem Digital Fairness Act vorgeschlagen, um Verbraucher:innen im Netz besser zu schützen. Und ja, die Vorschläge sind sinnvoll. Aber leider werden sie nicht annähernd ausreichen, um das grundsätzliche Problem zu lösen.
Denn wer online einkauft, spielt, sich informiert, auf Social Media unterwegs ist oder auch nur mal schauen will, was Übernachtungen in den Schulferien auf einer autofreien Insel kosten (Spoiler: vielleicht doch besser Camping?), ist einer Vielzahl an Tricks und Beeinflussungsversuchen ausgesetzt. Und auch wenn die Tricks zwar unterschiedlich daherkommen, beruhen viele von ihnen auf dem gleichen Problem: dem umfangreichen Sammeln und Auswerten persönlicher und persönlichster Daten und deren Nutzung für Werbezwecke. Trackingbranche
Es ist das Fundament für die Geschäftsmodelle zahlreicher Onlineplattformen und für das riesige, weitverzweigte Netz der Werbe- und Trackingbranche dahinter. Wer also nicht nur für vereinzelte Verbesserungen sorgen will, muss an dieses Geschäftsmodell ran. Davon ist aber leider in der Gesetzgebung nichts zu sehen, im Gegenteil.
taz debatte
Die taz ist eine unabhängige, linke und meinungsstarke Tageszeitung. In unseren Kommentaren, Essays und Debattentexten streiten wir seit der Gründung der taz im Jahr 1979. Oft können und wollen wir uns nicht auf eine Meinung einigen. Deshalb finden sich hier teils komplett gegenläufige Positionen – allesamt Teil des sehr breiten linken Meinungsspektrums.
Auch wenn die EU-Kommission aktuell Verbesserungen für den Schutz von Verbraucher:innen im Netz vorgeschlagen hat – an anderer Stelle ist sie dabei, den Schutz zu schwächen. Nämlich mit einem Gesetzespaket, das Bürokratie im Digitalen abbauen und Regeln für Unternehmen vereinfachen soll, unterm Strich aber ein Geschenk für die Wirtschaft und ein Rückschritt für die Nutzer:innen ist. https://www.humanite.fr/societe/marseill.author: Florent Le Du
https://www.humanite.fr/societe/marseill.text:
Depuis le 19 octobre, cinq narcotrafiquants sont entendus par la cour d’assises d’Aix-en-Provence, soupçonnés d’avoir participé aux meurtres de trois jeunes en 2020. Des faits macabres, inhumains, comme l’ont raconté certains d’entre eux lors des audiences, qui en disent long sur les méthodes pratiquées dans ce milieu ces dernières années. Le verdict est attendu ce vendredi 13 novembre.
Une « barbarie poussée à l’extrême », des meurtres d’une « sauvagerie sans nom », marqués par « la fourberie, la lâcheté, la trahison ». Mercredi 11 novembre, dans une salle d’audience où la tension et la sidération ne retombent pas depuis trois semaines, le ministère public a ainsi résumé les faits reprochés aux cinq prévenus, liés au narcotrafic de la DZ Mafia.
Soit le triple assassinat, la 29 décembre 2020, de Réda Khaldi, Nassim Loubani, et Brahim Chabane. Ce dernier était le demi-frère d’Amine Kessaci, devenu depuis une figure de la lutte contre les narcotrafiquants. Sur le banc des parties civiles, le jeune élu marseillais a suivi chaque minute du procès, à la cour d’assises d’Aix-en-Provence (Bouches-du-Rhône), soutenant régulièrement le regard des suspects....

https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.title: Pedro Pinheiro lança álbum que resgata a memória e a resistência do povo caboclo do Contestado
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.author: Redação
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.text:
A música como instrumento de memória, resistência e valorização da história popular. É essa a proposta de “Canções do Contestado”, novo álbum do músico, trovador e compositor Pedro Pinheiro, que será lançado na quinta-feira (19), às 20h, no Centro de Educação de Jovens e Adultos (Ceja), em São Miguel do Oeste (SC). Posteriormente, o trabalho estará disponível no Spotify.
O disco reúne canções inspiradas na história do Contestado e no universo do povo caboclo catarinense, cuja trajetória, segundo o artista, permanece muitas vezes escondida atrás das narrativas oficiais sobre a ocupação e a formação da região. “Quero cantar o povo de que faço parte, com o qual me identifico. Sua luta, sua fé e sua memória, resgatada pela luta pela terra, por moradia, por dignidade”, afirma Pinheiro.
Professor de História, além de músico e compositor, o trovador encontra na criação musical outra forma de compartilhar conhecimentos e manter viva a memória coletiva. Suas composições nascem tanto de leituras e pesquisas quanto das vivências em territórios marcados pela história do conflito. “Cantar e compor a história em múltiplos espaços é manter viva a memória”, destaca.
Arte para provocar e resistir
Para Pinheiro, a história do Contestado não se esgota e precisa ser revisitada a partir de diferentes olhares. O artista considera que a música pode despertar o interesse da população por histórias e personagens que nem sempre encontram espaço nos registros oficiais. Ele também defende uma arte comprometida com a reflexão e a transformação social, para além do entretenimento.
“Precisamos sair do convencional, não cantar para festa apenas, mas cantar para provocar, chamar atenção, propor outras visões de mundo. Esse papel deveria ser de toda a arte”, afirma. Natural de Guarujá do Sul (SC), Pinheiro lançou seu primeiro álbum, “Um Outro Olhar do Sul”, em 2019, também marcado por composições autorais e uma leitura crítica das realidades da região Sul do Brasil.
No novo trabalho, com violões, viola caipira, gaita e percussão, o trovador aprofunda sua relação com a história e a identidade popular do território do Contestado. “Infelizmente, a lógica mercadológica está muito mais acessível, mas a gente segue resistindo, cantando que outro mundo é possível”, conclui.
O álbum foi realizado com recursos da Política Nacional Aldir Blanc de Fomento à Cultura (Pnab), por meio do município de São Miguel do Oeste e do Ministério da Cultura.

https://taz.de/Stellengesuch/!6229450/.title: Stellengesuch: Über Plastikwörter, Pommes und den Standort Deutschland
https://taz.de/Stellengesuch/!6229450/.author: Sabine Nuss
https://taz.de/Stellengesuch/!6229450/.text:
Stellengesuch: Über Plastikwörter, Pommes und den Standort Deutschland
Wirtschaftsjournalisten verwenden gerne Wörter, die die wichtigen Sachen verschleiern. Das ist auf Dauer so schwer bekömmlich wie Pommes und Burger.
E s gibt Tage, da überblättere ich den Wirtschaftsteil der Zeitung. Ich ignoriere „Wirtschaft vor acht“, meide alles auf Social Media, was mit „Aktien“, „Märkten“ oder „Wirtschaftsstandort“ zu tun hat, und stelle das Radio auf einen Sender, der nur Musik spielt. Es gibt viele solcher Tage. 180 im Jahr vielleicht. Das ist schlecht, weil ich davon lebe, über Kapitalismus zu schreiben. Wirtschaft ist zwar nicht der ganze Kapitalismus, aber doch ein nicht ganz unerheblicher Teil davon. Ein Dilemma. Aber ich muss das machen, Wirtschafts-Detox. Für meine mentale Gesundheit.
Es ist ein bisschen wie damals, als ich bei McDonald’s gejobbt habe und aufhören musste. Nicht nur, weil der Schichtführer ein Choleriker war, sondern weil mir schlecht wurde. In der Mittagspause durften wir essen, was das Herz begehrt, im Wert von sieben Mark fünfzig. Irgendwann waren mir Pommes und Cheeseburger zuwider. Die heiße Fettwolke der Fritteuse beim Pommesholen, der zischende Bratdampf beim Wenden der tiefgefrorenen Fleischtaler. Es ging nicht mehr. Also ging ich.
Überdrüssig bin ich zum Beispiel dessen, was ich neulich in der Zeitung des Kapitals lesen musste, an einem Tag, an dem ich doch mal wieder ins Wirtschaftsressort geklickt hatte. Der Präsident des Maschinenbauerverbandes VDMA hatte ein Interview gegeben. Der Standort Deutschland, so wiederholte er das Mantra der herrschenden Politik, stehe kurz vor dem Kipppunkt. Fehlende Wettbewerbsfähigkeit, unflexibler Arbeitsmarkt, Reformstau, zu viel Bürokratie. Pommes, Pommes, Pommes. Die Antwort? Pommes: niedrigere Unternehmenssteuern, geringere Sozialabgaben, eine Stunde mehr Arbeit pro Woche, ein paar Jahre später in Rente. Diese „Anforderungen an den Standort“ bräuchten Verständnis in der Bevölkerung, führte er aus, „und ein Wissen, dass es damit besser wird“. Ungefähr so hat es die DDR-Nomenklatura auch gepredigt: „So wie wir heute arbeiten, werden wir morgen leben.“ Das hätte der Maschinenbauchef seinerzeit Propaganda genannt.
Kolumne Klassenfahrt
Sabine Nuss hat die zwölfte Klasse abgebrochen, Bürokauffrau gelernt, das Abitur nachgeholt, bei Springer als Journalistin volontiert, Politikwissenschaft studiert und über Privateigentum promoviert. Bei der Rosa-Luxemburg-Stiftung war sie Leiterin der politischen Kommunikation und Geschäftsführerin des Karl Dietz Verlags. Heute lebt sie als freie Autorin, Publizistin und Podcast-Host in Berlin. In ihrer Kolumne führt sie uns regelmäßig durch die Nebelregion des Kapitalismus. Sie lüftet den Schleier der Verhältnisse, in denen es scheint, als seien wir alle frei und gleich.
Wachstum, Innovation oder Strategie sind „Plastikwörter“
Solange es kein Raus gibt, muss ich diese Anrufung wohl ertragen. Und ein Raus gibt es nicht, solange das Dilemma „unserer Wirtschaft“ nicht durchschaut wird. Es liegt darin, dass wir unser Wohl und Wehe von der selbstzweckhaften Vermehrung des Kapitals abhängig gemacht haben, dass wir uns von den Vollziehern dieser Logik global in ein Rennen um schneller, höher, weiter hetzen lassen. In den Worten des Maschinenbauchefs zur angeblich immer bedrohlicheren Konkurrenz aus China: „Wir haben eine China-Position, die allerdings zu zwei Dritteln aus Anforderungen an den Standort Deutschland besteht.“
Die größte Hürde ist, dass Kapitalvermehrung als Anreiz und Konkurrenz als Handlungsstruktur für natürlich gehalten werden (von den meisten) und als die beste aller möglichen Welten gepriesen werden (von den Gewinnern).
Dazu passt die Sprache. Märkte, die nervös sind, sich erholen oder kränkeln, Preise, die steigen oder fallen. Wirtschaft – ein mit einem Eigenleben begabter Organismus. Wer unten steht, wer oben und wer profitiert? Unsichtbar. Der Linguist Uwe Pörksen nannte Wörter wie Wachstum, Innovation oder Strategie „Plastikwörter“: Sie klingen nach Sachverstand, passen auf alles und sagen nie, wer handelt. Standort und Wettbewerbsfähigkeit sind aus ähnlichem Stoff. Die Wirtschaftsberichterstattung ist voller Plastik. Deshalb: Detox. Oder einen neuen Job. Bitte ohne Pommes.

https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfre.title: Thanks to American oligarchy, Jensen Huang’s midlife crisis is a problem for all of us | Moira Donegan
https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfre.author: Moira Donegan
https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfre.text:
One of the reasons you want to distribute power and responsibility in powerful organizations and high-stakes enterprises is so that the narcissism or myopia of one man do not come to carry outsized consequences.
When power is spread out across multiple people, it matters less if one of those people is prone to flattery, or in the midst of a midlife crisis, or perhaps just a bit stupid; the limits on his power become limits on the fallout of his character flaws.
A broad distribution of authority also has the virtue of making any one man disposable, replaceable: if he turns out to have poor judgement or counterproductive preoccupations, he can be dispensed with, and his role can be filled anew with someone better suited to its responsibilities.
But if one man becomes synonymous with a company – or a country – then untold numbers of other people live and die by that man’s decisions. And when his decisions are bad – petty, selfish, shortsighted, small-minded or dumb – then it is other people who will pay the price. And the price is often quite steep.
Because we live in an era of massive inequality, tightly consolidated corporate leadership, and rule by a billionaire class with large egos and deficient dignity, the US economy is now experiencing one of the latter scenarios, in the form of Jensen Huang, a Silicon Valley billionaire who this week confessed to having an extramarital affair.
This would be tacky and embarrassing for Huang on its own. But because Huang is the longtime CEO of Nvidia, one of the country’s largest companies and the manufacturer of advanced chip technology that is powering the US’s AI boom, his petty midlife crisis – the kind of small-minded narcissism that can usually be dispensed with in the form of a red sportscar, or indeed with one of the cheesy leather jackets that Huang is prone to wearing – is now a problem for the US economy, and potentially for national security.
Because Huang’s mistress was not just any of the interchangeable young women that such men usually go for. This one happened to be a suspected Chinese spy.
It’s unclear how much the woman, Huang Le, also known as Alice Huang – no relation – learned from her relationship with the tech billionaire, or how the information she may have gathered could undermine US economic and military interests.
Alice Huang worked in television in China before becoming an executive at Megaspeed, a Singapore-based tech company and one of the largest purchasers of Nvidia’s advanced chips. Megaspeed was under investigation by the US commerce department on suspicion of smuggling the advanced chips to China, which is banned from importing them by US law. (Megaspeed said it had offered to cooperate with the US government’s investigation but those offers went unanswered.)
According to the New York Times, the investigation was abruptly halted last year after the general counsel for Nvidia, Jensen Huang’s company, intervened. Among other things, Jensen Huang is known for his close relationship with Donald Trump.
On Sunday, Huang issued a statement admitting to an affair, and his company announced that it would be launching an investigation into the incident. “The Board has no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised,” which is perhaps a bit too hopeful. On Thursday, Huang stepped down as Nvidia’s CEO.
But the statement itself is a reflection of the depth of Huang’s control over the country. If you or I had endangered corporate secrets and state security in a flight of reckless, narcissistic frivolity, the way Huang may have done, then our employers would not be announcing the investigation while we kept our jobs. Nvidia’s stocks were down when the markets opened on Monday. They may well go down further still.
And yet the scandal is fitting for our current era of Silicon Valley, in which loyalty to Donald Trump has gone from a strategic move by major tech companies to ensure favorable contract and regulatory terms to much more full-throated embrace of the ideology and style of the far right.
Following the lead of its major male executives, the tech industry has become reckless and irresponsible, proud of itself for accelerating technologies it plainly claims to be unable to control, demanding investments in datacenters and government contracts from taxpayers whom it smugly brags about putting out of jobs, and flooding our aesthetic and informational worlds with low-grade slop that is frequently factually inaccurate, often dangerous for vulnerable users, and uncanny in its unpleasantness, bearing a creepy and inhuman sheen in its images and language.
The leaders of this industry seem oblivious to how they appear to other people, and perhaps, insulated by their money and their sycophantic underlings, it does not occur to them that nobody wants the future that they are ushering in, the one they are insisting we all must pay for.
How much money does it take to be so cut off from reality? How much money did Jensen Huang need to have before he convinced himself that Alice Huang, pale, skinny, and fluttering her eyelashes at him at a conference, liked him for his personality?
- Moira Donegan is a Guardian US columnist
- This article was updated on 12 November 2026 to incorporate Huang’s resignation.

https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.title: Em reunião com enviados de Trump, Putin propõe trégua humanitária em Donetsk e cobra posição da UE
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.author: Serguei Monin
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.text:
Os enviados especiais do presidente dos EUA, Jared Kushner e Steve Witkoff, se reuniram com o presidente russo, Vladimir Putin, nesta quinta-feira (12), em Moscou, para discutir a resolução da guerra da Ucrânia.
Durante a reunião, o presidente russo propôs realizar uma missão humanitária para evacuar civis na região de Kostiantynivka, a exemplo da trégua humanitária temporária que foi realizada na região de Oleskhy. Também foi discutido o papel da UE nas negociações.
“Há um assentamento em Donbas chamado Kostiantynivka, onde ainda vivem cerca de 400 a 500 civis. Vamos fazer o mesmo que fizemos em Oleshky e convidar representantes da imprensa estrangeira, incluindo a imprensa americana”, disse ele.
Kostiantynivka é hoje uma das áreas mais tensas do combate na linha de frente na região de Donetsk. Os confrontos prosseguem não apenas nas proximidades, mas também dentro da própria cidade. As tropas russas continuam sua ofensiva, tentando estabelecer uma posição na área urbana enquanto pressionam simultaneamente as defesas ucranianas por diversas direções.
Segundo Putin, a Rússia precisará de cinco dias para remover as minas terrestres próximas à cidade. Ele propôs que a organização da missão fosse confiada à Comissária Russa para os Direitos Humanos, Yana Lantratova, e ao Comissário do Parlamento Ucraniano para os Direitos Humanos, Dmitry Lubinets.
Os enviados de Donald Trump chegaram a Moscou logo após as reuniões trilaterais entre representantes de Rússia, Ucrânia e EUA, em 10 e 11 de novembro, em Abu Dhabi. Witkoff afirmou que a troca de prisioneiros entre a Rússia e a Ucrânia, acertada nas negociações de ontem, indica progresso na resolução do conflito.
Ele acrescentou que transmitiria ao líder ucraniano Volodymyr Zelenskyy informações sobre os contatos de hoje com Vladimir Putin.
Antes da reunião com Putin, o assessor presidencial russo, Yuri Ushakov, havia declarado que seriam discutidas “diversas questões que levariam a uma resolução duradoura da crise na Ucrânia“. O ministro das Relações Exteriores da Rússia, Sergey Lavrov, afirmou que Putin “determinará posições futuras com base no que ouvir dos americanos”.
Tropas estrangeiras e disputas territoriais
Outro ponto destacado pelo presidente russo foi a questão da presença de tropas estrangeiras na Ucrânia. Segundo o líder, elas seriam um alvo legítimo para as Forças Armadas Russas, pois a possibilidade de sua presença no território ucraniano representaria uma ameaça à segurança nacional da Rússia.
“Dissemos desde o início que a presença de quaisquer tropas estrangeiras em território ucraniano é absolutamente inaceitável para nós, porque acreditamos que isso ameaça a segurança da Federação Russa”, disse Putin durante a reunião.
Ele também enfatizou que, quando se trata de disputas territoriais, as pessoas que vivem nesses territórios são a questão mais importante para a Rússia.
“Sabemos que ambos os lados entendem as questões territoriais de forma diferente. O que é mais importante para nós são as pessoas que vivem lá, suas tradições, sua cultura, seu direito de viver segundo suas próprias regras, seu direito de viver de acordo com seus valores tradicionais”, disse o líder russo.
Diálogo com a Europa
Ao falar sobre o papel da União Europeia nas negociações, Putin afirmou que a Rússia nunca se opôs ao diálogo com a Europa. O presidente russo instou os parceiros estadunidenses a trabalhar com os europeus.
“Nunca nos opusemos ao diálogo com a Europa. E nunca o interrompemos”, disse Putin na reunião com os enviados presidenciais especiais dos EUA.
O presidente Vladimir Putin afirmou a necessidade de os países europeus finalmente decidirem entre a paz e a guerra. O líder russo expressou o desejo de ver os resultados do engajamento dos EUA com seus parceiros na Europa.
“Gostaríamos muito que vocês, estimados senhores, e a administração americana como um todo, trabalhassem com seus conselheiros europeus para que pudessem finalmente decidir o que querem: paz ou guerra”, declarou Putin.

Bethlehem Church of the Nativity priest denied visa to speak at US event
Father Issa Thaljieh, the Palestinian parish priest at the Church of the Nativity in Bethlehem, in the occupied West Bank, has been denied a US visa to speak alongside American clergy next week on the gravity of Israeli settler attacks on Palestinian villages.
"Our government denied him a visa for 'security reasons'. A parish priest from Bethlehem, treated as a threat. That should worry all of us, because it means the people living through this are being kept from telling us about it," Laila Mokhiber, a volunteer with Orthodox Christians for Palestine (OCP), told Middle East Eye on Thursday.
MEE has reached out to the State Department.
Catholic, Orthodox, and Protestant leaders are set to gather at the United Methodist Building near the US Capitol on Monday to demand that Congress hold accountable both settlers and the Israeli military, and also curb US weapons transfers to Israel.

https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/1.text:
Yemen’s Houthis renew strikes on Saudi Arabia as UNSC extends sanctions
Saudi-led coalition intercepts flurry of suspected Houthi missiles, drones targeting oil, military infrastructure.
Saudi-led coalition forces have said they intercepted suspected Houthi drones over Saudi Arabia’s Riyadh region and Eastern Province, as the UN Security Council agreed to extend sanctions on the Iran-allied group.
Major General Turki al-Maliki, the spokesperson for the Saudi-led coalition, announced the interceptions of suspected Houthi drones on Thursday, in a statement carried by the Saudi Press Agency.
Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree said the group had targeted oil infrastructure and military assets in the kingdom, including a pumping station on the East-West Pipeline with a drone as well as the Yanbu oil facility on the Red Sea.
Riyadh says it has rerouted about 4 million barrels of crude per day via its East-West Pipeline to Yanbu, equivalent to about 4 percent of global supply.
Saree further claimed a military cargo plane at Sharurah airport close to Yemen’s border was targeted with a drone, while a ballistic missile launched towards Khamis Mushait airbase “scored a direct hit”.
The Houthi spokesperson added that their forces had targeted the Saudi Aramco headquarters in the capital, Riyadh, but rejected as a “grave falsehood” a Saudi assertion that the group had targeted the kingdom’s Mecca region on Wednesday.
Saudi-backed coalition forces fighting on behalf of Yemen’s internationally recognised government say they continue to confront the Houthis across all frontlines, targeting leaders, vehicles, reinforcements, weapons and positions.
Yemen’s Defence Ministry, citing the Saudi-backed Presidential Leadership Council, said the battle against the Houthis was moving towards its “desired objectives”, according to Yemen’s official pro-government Saba news agency.
A meeting convened by the Defence Ministry was held in the Marib governorate to discuss the ongoing operations against the Houthis, where ways to enhance coordination and integration between various military units that are part of the Dawn of Yemen offensive were also discussed.
Security Council extends sanctions
On Thursday, the United Nations Security Council (UNSC) unanimously voted in favour of extending sanctions related to Yemen for one more year, including freezing assets and enforcing travel bans, while demanding an end to Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia.
The mandate for the UN Panel of Experts on Yemen, which made the recommendations, was also extended.
UNSC members called on “all parties to refrain from escalatory actions and to resolve differences and disputes through negotiation”, while also backing the territorial integrity of both Saudi Arabia and Yemen.
“The resolution condemns the military escalation by the Houthis, their maritime and cross-border attacks against Saudi Arabia, and their threats to commercial shipping vessels,” the UNSC statement said.
The resolution emphasised that measures taken for the purpose of maintaining sanctions “shall not apply to humanitarian assistance or supplies for basic needs of civilians, without negatively affecting legitimate trade activities”.
“The council sanctions are merely a means, not an end in themselves,” said Ambassador Fu Cong, China’s envoy to the UN, who hoped that “the situation in Yemen will de-escalate as soon as possible”.
333,000 displaced
On Thursday, the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) said more than 333,000 people have been displaced in Yemen since the beginning of August, including more than 24,000 displaced in the past week.
Civilians “continue to pay a heavy price as violence damages health facilities, forces families from their homes, and hinders the work of humanitarians”, OCHA said.
Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia is pressing the European Union to adopt an EU Parliament resolution to designate the Ansar Allah Houthi movement as a “terrorist organisation”, according to the Reuters news agency, citing sources familiar with the drive.
But European officials told Reuters the bloc is concerned this could undermine a future peace process.
EU foreign policy spokesperson Anouar El-Anouni said the bloc was in regular contact with Riyadh on regional developments, but declined to comment on any specific discussions under way, according to Reuters.

https://jacobin.com/2026/11/conservative.title: Reactionary Feminists Offer Bad Solutions to Real Problems
https://jacobin.com/2026/11/conservative.author: Kaja Kröger
https://jacobin.com/2026/11/conservative.text:
Reactionary Feminists Offer Bad Solutions to Real Problems
Reactionary feminist writers Mary Harrington and Louise Perry dress up arguments for marriage and sexual restraint in Marxist rhetoric. But they also point to the limits of liberal feminism — limits that the Left needs to grapple with.
To more and more people, the promises of sex-positive liberal feminism feel empty. The sexual ideas that have dominated feminism in the last two decades — including that sexual liberation always serves women’s interests, that consent is the only relevant sexual ethic, and that consuming porn and buying sex are benign practices like any other — are beginning to ring hollow.
In this context, an emergent theoretical strand with the pointed, self-chosen name “reactionary feminism” has drawn considerable attention. It calls into question the liberal assertion that every form of sexual morality is anti-feminist — a view the Left has absorbed in recent decades. Although they work to maintain an appearance of ideological ambivalence, reactionary feminists are aligned with the post-liberal right, and they are finding success in attracting to that project women who are disenchanted with feminism’s wholesale embrace of sexual openness for its own sake. Their prescriptions are often at odds with what many feminists would consider emancipatory, but they are identifying real flaws in liberal feminism, and the Left should take notice.
At the forefront of this new conservative feminism are British authors Mary Harrington and Louise Perry. Both have written popular books on how postwar sexual liberation in the West has failed women.

Russian court jails rights lawyer for 12 years on treason charge
Prosecutors say the woman shared security details with Ukraine, while her lawyers argue the information wasn’t secret.
A court in Russia’s Baltic exclave of Kaliningrad has sentenced a 66-year-old rights lawyer to 12 years in prison for treason, after prosecutors accused her of passing sensitive information to Ukraine.
The court imposed the sentence on Thursday on Maria Bontsler, according to the rights group Slovo Zashchite, which said she had worked with a number of defendants accused of political offences in Kaliningrad.
The territory sits on the Baltic Sea between Lithuania and Poland.
A court statement posted on Telegram did not name her, but said she had been detained by the FSB intelligence agency on allegations of passing information to Ukraine beginning in 2024 about security officers in Kaliningrad.
Prosecutors also alleged she gave Ukraine information on criminal cases in the exclave that were of interest to Kyiv, the statement said.
She was also given an extra year of restrictions on her activity. Prosecutors had sought 15 years, according to Slovo Zashchite.
Closed trial
Slovo Zashchite said the trial was held behind closed doors, with Bontsler and her lawyers prevented from attending, and that she was allowed only to make a closing statement. It said her lawyers argued that none of the information cited by prosecutors was secret, and that she had been in ill health in detention.
Since Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, parliament has approved laws that make public actions aimed at “discrediting” the army illegal and ban the spread of “fake news” about the armed forces.
Russian courts have also jailed lawyers who took on politically sensitive cases. In January 2025, a court sentenced three lawyers of the late opposition leader Alexey Navalny to between three and a half and five and a half years on “extremism” charges, in a case widely seen as an effort to discourage defence lawyers from taking political cases.

https://www.humanite.fr/en-debat/attenta.title: « Quand le racisme tue, le silence devient une faute »
https://www.humanite.fr/en-debat/attenta.author: Tribunes
https://www.humanite.fr/en-debat/attenta.text:
Élus locaux socialistes et écologistes, les signataires de ce texte dénoncent l’absence des représentants de la droite « républicaine » des rassemblements antiracistes après l’attentat meurtrier de Trappes. Ils rappellent que le racisme discursif arme le bras des assassins et nourrit les logiques de discrimination. Ils appellent Valérie Pécresse, présidente de la Région Île-de-France, à organiser des assises de lutte contre le racisme.
Le 23 octobre dernier, à Trappes et à La Verrière, le racisme a tué. Pengo Bossio Wangi, 26 ans, a été assassiné et plusieurs personnes ont été blessées, dont une enfant de douze ans, touchée par huit balles. Le terroriste a reconnu avoir délibérément ciblé des personnes qu’il percevait comme musulmanes, africaines ou nord-africaines, après avoir ingurgité des heures de discours haineux.
Ce drame trouve ses racines dans une société où les digues de l’humanisme tombent une par une. L’histoire nous montre comment des institutions censées garantir le bon fonctionnement d’une saine démocratie peuvent basculer, à mesure qu’elles se compromettent dans l’essor de la bête immonde.
Les milliers de personnes réunies à Trappes le 30 octobre ont rappelé que, pour nombre de Françaises et de Français, la haine raciste est inacceptable. Et pourtant, disons-le sans ambages, beaucoup ont manqué à cet appel.
Pourquoi les principales figures du centre et de la droite ont-elles choisi de ne pas se joindre à ce rassemblement ? Qu’avaient-elles de mieux à faire que de répondre à l’unité solennelle du peuple français ? Considèrent-elles que la haine raciste est un enjeu secondaire, « sociétal » diraient certains ?
Car le racisme n’est pas une abstraction. Sous ses différentes formes, il possède des ressorts particuliers. L’antisémitisme plonge ses racines dans des siècles de persécutions antijuives européennes dont la Shoah constitue l’aboutissement génocidaire et continue aujourd’hui de se réinventer.
La négrophobie porte l’héritage de l’esclavage et de la domination coloniale, qui ont construit et diffusé des représentations déshumanisantes des populations noires. L’islamophobie s’inscrit, elle aussi, dans une histoire coloniale, particulièrement celle de la domination française au Maghreb, et trouve aujourd’hui dans les discours de l’extrême droite un puissant instrument de propagation. Et toutes ces formes de racisme perdurent dans nos imaginaires français, que nous le voulions ou non. Il ne suffit pas de décréter par une loi la prohibition du racisme pour que celui-ci s’envole, évanescent.
Simone de Beauvoir écrivait que « Nommer c’est dévoiler, et dévoiler c’est agir ». Levons le voile sur les responsables de cette banalisation du racisme. Au premier chef, l’extrême droite porte une responsabilité politique dans la diffusion de ces représentations. Son ADN identitaire est intrinsèquement celui de l’exclusion.
Des « quatre États confédérés » de Maurras (les protestants, les juifs, les francs-maçons et les métèques) à la préférence nationale de Marine Le Pen, le fil est ininterrompu et sans cassure, n’en déplaise aux tartuffes de la prétendue « dédiabolisation ».
Mais elle ne prospérerait pas autant sans les relais qui lui permettent d’imposer ses thèmes. Une partie des médias, notamment certaines chaînes d’information en continu, contribue à transformer les préjugés racistes en sujets ordinaires de débat. À force de parler d’immigration comme d’une menace et des musulmans comme d’un problème, s’est installé un imaginaire de la suspicion généralisée. Entre les « bons » Français et ceux dont on suspecte l’authenticité.
Cette responsabilité dépasse largement les frontières de l’extrême droite. Les responsables de la droite dite républicaine participent eux aussi de la banalisation de ces discours. La course à l’échalote du propos le plus répressif bat des records en ces temps d’élection présidentielle.
Comment ne pas être outré d’entendre David Lisnard déclarer toute honte bue « je m’en fous », lorsqu’il est interrogé sur le massacre des Algériens du 17 octobre 1961 ? Comment ne pas être outré lorsque Édouard Philippe affirme devant des millions de téléspectateurs avoir vu parmi les pilleurs une « surreprésentation de jeunes issus de l’immigration », lui qui avait quelques mois plus tôt osé affirmer que la colonisation n’était pas un crime ?
La bascule de la droite dite « républicaine » n’est pas encore irrémédiable ; encore faut-il qu’elle comprenne qu’en reprenant à son compte les mots de l’extrême droite elle lui ouvre les voies de l’Élysée.
Le racisme discursif provoque aussi des conséquences pratiques. Sa finalité, au bout du spectre, pouvant aller jusqu’à l’attentat terroriste. Mais avant cela, il produit très concrètement des inégalités matérielles, mesurables. Dans le logement, une campagne de testing menée en 2025 par SOS Racisme a montré que 96 des 198 agences immobilières sollicitées, soit 48,5 %, acceptaient ou facilitaient une demande de discrimination raciale.
Autrement dit, près d’une agence sur deux était disposée à écarter des candidats en raison de leur origine. Dans son rapport de février 2026, le Défenseur des droits rappelle également qu’en Île-de-France, un jeune actif perçu comme originaire d’Afrique subsaharienne ou d’outre-mer a 40 % de chances en moins d’obtenir une réponse positive à une demande de logement qu’un candidat perçu comme d’origine française ; un jeune actif d’origine maghrébine en a 37 % de moins ; un jeune actif perçu comme asiatique, 20 % de moins.
Le constat est tout aussi accablant dans l’emploi. Selon une étude de la Dares publiée en 2021, à qualité de candidature comparable, un candidat dont le nom suggère une origine maghrébine a 32 % de chances en moins d’être contacté par un recruteur qu’un candidat portant un nom d’origine française.
Même diplôme, même expérience, mêmes compétences, seule change l’origine supposée. Voilà ce que produit concrètement une société dans laquelle l’égalité proclamée ne garantit pas l’égalité réelle. Voilà les conséquences réelles des discours.
Face à cette réalité, il ne suffit plus de répéter que le racisme est condamnable. Une condamnation morale qui ne s’accompagne d’aucune transformation des structures sociales et politiques risque de rester une incantation.
Il faut multiplier les testings, renforcer les contrôles et les sanctions contre les discriminations, garantir la transparence des procédures de recrutement et d’attribution des logements, donner aux associations antiracistes les moyens d’agir, enseigner sans détour l’histoire coloniale et combattre par le droit la diffusion des discours de haine dans l’espace médiatique.
Dans ce cadre, nous demandons solennellement à la présidente de la Région Île-de-France Valérie Pécresse d’organiser des assises de lutte contre le racisme, et de faire de cette dernière la grande cause régionale de 2027.
Ce n’est pas en se poussant du col républicain et en ânonnant à l’envi « les valeurs de la République » devant des jeunes Françaises et Français qui souffrent que l’on parviendra à lutter contre la croissance du racisme. Dans le film « Les rayons et les ombres », le procureur admoneste le collaborateur Jean Luchaire dans son réquisitoire en reprenant cette formule de Charles Dantzig : « Les mots des salauds arment les bras des imbéciles ».
Que ceux qui passent leur temps à attiser les braises du racisme soient conscients de leur responsabilité au regard de l’histoire qui vient.
Les signataires
- Aïssata Seck, Conseillère régionale et directrice de la Fondation pour la mémoire d’esclavage
- Nadège Azzaz, Conseillère régionale et maire de Châtillon
- Isabelle Beressi, Conseillère régionale
- Emmanuelle Cosse, Conseillère régionale
- Hélène De Comarmond, Conseillère régionale et maire de Cachan
- Adrien Delacroix, Conseiller régional et conseiller municipal de Saint-Denis
- Maxime Des Gayets, Conseiller régional et adjoint au maire de Paris
- Dieynaba Diop, Conseillère régionale et députée des Yvelines
- Jean-Marc Germain, Conseiller régional et député européen
- Jérôme Guedj, Conseiller régional et député de l’Essonne
- Florent Hubert, Conseiller régional
- Jonathan Kienzlen, président du groupe Socialiste, Écologiste et Radical à la région Île-de-France et adjoint au maire d’Alfortville
- Hadrien Laurent, Conseiller régional
- Stéphanie Le Meur, Conseillère régionale et adjointe au maire de Moissy-Cramayel
- Paul Miguel, Conseiller régional
- Audrey Pulvar, Conseillère régionale et adjointe au maire de Paris
- Roberto Romero, Conseiller régional
- Rachid Temal, Conseiller régional et sénateur du Val-d’Oise
- Yannick Trigance, Conseiller régional
Face à l’extrême droite, ne rien lâcher !
C’est pied à pied, argument contre argument qu’il faut combattre l’extrême droite. Et c’est ce que nous faisons chaque jour dans l’Humanité.
Face aux attaques incessantes des racistes et des porteurs de haine : soutenez-nous ! Ensemble, faisons entendre une autre voix dans ce débat public toujours plus nauséabond.
Je veux en savoir plus.

https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/11.text:
Italy fight back to beat France 3-1 and move top of Nations League group
Michael Olise gives France the lead, but double from Pio Esposito and one from Davide Frattesi secures win for Italy.
Francesco Pio Esposito struck twice to inflict a first defeat on Zinedine Zidane as France’s head coach, while Italy stormed back to win 3-1 at San Siro and top their Nations League group.
Michael Olise profited from a Gianluigi Donnarumma error to put the visitors in front after 10 minutes on Thursday, but Italy hit back through Esposito and Davide Frattesi either side of half-time.
Inter Milan striker Esposito’s second came from the penalty spot after his brother Sebastiano had earlier fired a spot kick wide, while France were twice denied by the woodwork in an entertaining encounter.
The result sent Italy top of Group A1 on 10 points, level with France but above them on head-to-head record, while Belgium are third on nine points after inflicting a fifth straight defeat on rock-bottom Turkiye.
France were without star attackers Kylian Mbappe and Ousmane Dembele through injury, but it did not show as they made an electric start in pouring rain in Milan.
Desire Doue hit the side netting and first-time captain Adrien Rabiot tested Donnarumma before Lucas Da Cunha’s rasping half-volley flew narrowly wide.
But the opener was gifted to France when Donnarumma passed the ball straight to Olise, who skipped past a defender before firing home his fifth goal in five Nations League games – a record only bettered by England captain Harry Kane’s seven.
The hosts struck back in the 26th minute with their first chance of the game when Nicolo Cambiaghi drove to the byline and cut back a cross, which Esposito converted with a deft touch.
The goal brought San Siro to life as the older Esposito sibling, Sebastiano, threatened a quickfire comeback two minutes later, forcing a sharp save from Mike Maignan.
Bradley Barcola came closest to a third goal before the break with a curling shot from the edge of the box that struck the foot of the far post.
The end-to-end nature of the game continued in the second half as Rayan Cherki’s rasping strike was tipped onto the post by Donnarumma before Italy charged up the other end and forced Maignan into a point-blank save from Cambiaghi.
Italy had a glorious chance to go in front when Cambiaghi was tripped by Malo Gusto to earn a penalty, but Sebastiano Esposito failed to join his brother on the scoresheet as he hammered his spot kick wide on the hour mark.
The Azzurri did not dwell on the disappointment for long, taking the lead just three minutes later when Frattesi drilled in a shot from a Federico Dimarco cross moments after the Inter Milan wing-back was brought off the bench.
Fellow substitute Antonio Vergara earned the home side another penalty when he was tripped by Dayot Upamecano, and this time Francesco Pio Esposito stepped up to drill a shot into the bottom corner.
The result continued a strong start to Roberto Mancini’s second spell as Italy coach as his side stretched their unbeaten run to four matches and notched their first home win over France since 1962.
Belgium host Italy and Turkiye travel to France in the final round of group games on Sunday.
Elsewhere, captain Harry Kane celebrated his record 126th cap for England with a match-winner from the penalty spot as England beat Croatia 2-1 at Wembley on Thursday to qualify for the Nations League last eight.
The 33-year-old followed a script that seemed destined to happen when he stepped up in the 64th minute to put England ahead in front of an 80,400-strong crowd after the hosts had conceded a sloppy equaliser five minutes earlier.
It was the Bayern Munich forward’s 92nd England goal, and there was never any doubt from the moment he placed the ball and sent it straight down the middle as goalkeeper Dominik Livakovic dived to his left.
Kane had started a night of celebration as the centre of attention, handed a commemorative token by former goalkeeper Peter Shilton, the previous record holder since 1989, when he surpassed Bobby Moore’s 108 caps.

https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026.title: Dozens of protesters arrested after staging sit-in at Chuck Schumer’s DC office
https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026.author: Lex McMenamin
https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026.text:
Dozens of protesters with the Sunrise Movement, a youth climate organization, were arrested after staging a sit-in inside Senate minority leader Chuck Schumer’s Washington DC office Thursday
According to the Sunrise Movement, 54 people were arrested, among a few hundred who joined the protest from across the country, including some from New York, which Schumer represents. On its Instagram, the group is fundraising $24,000 to cover the bail fees and any potential legal fees for those arrested.
Capitol police were not immediately available for comment.
In a clip on the Sunrise Movement’s Instagram, with over 40,000 likes at the time of publication, young people sitting on the office floor chanted: “Hey hey, ho ho, Schumer has got to go!” Protesters, including children, held signs reading “The filibuster kills,” “Stop the climate crisis,” and “Schumer: Step up or step aside.”
As Senate Democrats prepare to vote on a majority leader for the upcoming Congress, they’re wrestling with how to navigate what feels like a clear mandate for anti-establishment voices from communities historically underrepresented in federal office to step into leadership. Several Democratic senators have said they will not support Schumer for the position, including Bernie Sanders, an independent who caucuses with the Democrats, as well as several members of the freshman class, like Michigan’s Abdul El-Sayed and South Carolina’s Annie Andrews.
Some have backed Maryland’s Chris Van Hollen as a challenger, including Peggy Flanagan, Minnesota’s senator-elect, and 50501, one of the major groups behind the No Kings protests.
The protesters on Thursday delivered a letter to Schumer arguing, per the group’s press release, that “after a collective decade of Schumer leadership it was time for change” and demanding Democrats prioritize ending the filibuster when Congress returns in January.
They also dropped the letters at the offices of every Senate Democrat. According to the Sunrise Movement’s campaigns director, Kidus Girma, Thursday’s action is one of several planned over the next two weeks targeting Senate Democrats and “demanding they actually take action”.
The group has regularly protested against politicians since first making headlines in 2018 with another sit-in targeting then-House speaker Nancy Pelosi, and helped launch calls for a Green New Deal alongside congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, who was part of that 2018 sit-in. In the eight years since, Sunrise has supported progressive candidates, and last week, a Sunrise co-founder, Will Lawrence, 36, won his race for a Michigan US House seat after campaigning against datacenters.
“Young people went to Senator Chuck Schumer’s office to demand a Senate majority leader that would fight for the young people who elected a historic blue wave last week. They’re demanding change, not the same old, same old,” said Girma over the phone.
According to early data from Tufts University’s Center for Information and Research on Civic Learning and Engagement (Circle), which monitors youth civic engagement, the 3 November elections saw the second-highest youth turnout for a midterm election in 30 years – following only the 2018 midterms in Donald Trump’s first term.
“Chuck Schumer has been in office longer than I have been alive, and I’m 31 years old,” Girmus said. “[Young people] didn’t vote for a return to the Biden years, but rather a change.”
This isn’t the first sit-in of Schumer’s office organized by young people to happen this week. On Tuesday, three protesters were arrested during a protest by the youth advocacy group Get Free, who were there saying voters “need Democratic leaders to meet the moment lest we repeat history again”, according to executive director Nicole Carty.
Last week, Girma said the election outcome “shows that young people deeply, deeply care about their futures and the current government – but also, they’re making clear demands around how to fix it”.
